    BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.

    Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.

    In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

    About BlockTech

    BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

    We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

    What will you do?

    You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

    You will:

    • Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

    • Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

    • Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

    • Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

    • Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

    • Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

    • Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

    • Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

    Who we are

    We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

     

    With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

     

    Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

     

    We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

    We’re on the search for...

    Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

    In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

    The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

    This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

     

    What you’ll be doing

    You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

    The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

    You’ll be:

    • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

    • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

    • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

    • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

    • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

    • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

    • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

    • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

    What we’re looking for

    Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

    • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

    • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

    • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

    • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

    • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

    • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

    • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

    • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

    Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

    Apply directly through our careers page.

     

    • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

    • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

     

    If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

    In the meantime

    If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.
  • Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.
  • Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.
  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest housing platform in Latin America. Driven by our shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we build technology and solutions that simplify the entire housing journey, from renting to buying and selling.

Operating across 6 countries (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama) and with a technology hub in Portugal, we bring together more than 3,100 people united by the challenge of transforming the real estate industry. Backed by top global investors such as SoftBank, General Atlantic, and Kaszek, we have raised over US$ 755 million and are valued at US$ 5.1 billion.

We lead market transformation as pioneers in large-scale Artificial Intelligence applications for the real estate sector. Our platforms welcome over 50 million monthly visits, managing more than 350,000 active rental contracts and processing R$ 20 billion in annual transaction value.

If you are looking to solve complex problems with autonomy, cutting-edge technology, and massive scale impact, come on in, the house is yours.

To learn more about our story, visit:

Location & Work Model

We operate under a remote-first model, giving you full flexibility to work from anywhere in Brazil. For those who enjoy in-person moments, we offer access to our office in São Paulo and partner coworking spaces. In addition, we have the Work From Anywhere (WFA) program, which allows you to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year.

About the Team & The Challenge

At QuintoAndar, Product Managers are at the core of our strategy, using technology and innovation to solve complex real-world problems and help people love where they live. We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic Senior Product Manager to lead high-impact workstreams and shape the future of our ecosystem. You will be responsible for driving the product vision, prioritizing big bets, and ensuring execution flows smoothly in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, directly impacting our transition into an AI-First company.

Your Responsibilities

  • Shape and execute the product vision and quarterly roadmap, translating complex business and user problems into scalable product solutions.

  • Lead a cross-functional squad—integrating engineering, design, data, and operations—to ensure seamless execution and high-quality deliveries.

  • Deep dive into execution and data, kicking off discovery streams, validating hypotheses, and testing new approaches before scaling.

  • Influence business strategy and coordinate cross-company initiatives, managing complex stakeholder relationships and aligning expectations with senior leadership.

  • Act as a role model for product excellence, bringing market insights, raising the bar for decision-making, and occasionally coaching more junior product team members.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

  • Solid product track record: proven experience as a Product Manager designing, building, and delivering high-impact, end-to-end digital solutions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: you are data-driven, comfortable navigating complex metrics, and capable of taking bold decisions based on factual data.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to gather inputs, handle pushbacks, and influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

  • User-centric mindset: ability to uncover real user requirements (even the unarticulated ones) and advocate for the best experience.

  • Fast-pace resilience: comfortable working with aggressive timelines and making quick adjustments in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Previous background in highly analytical positions, such as strategy consulting, data science, or operations, combined with hands-on product experience.

  • Experience working on complex marketplaces, platform foundations, or AI-centric products.

  • Advanced or fluent English skills.

What Is Our Selection Process Like?

We designed a transparent and straightforward journey focused on evaluating your technical and behavioral potential, while giving you the opportunity to get to know our teams and career paths:

  1. Application and Profile Review
  2. Interview with People Team
  3. Case Study
  4. Hiring Manager Interview
  5. Stakeholder Interview
  6. Offer & Welcome!


Important: We review all applications individually and guarantee feedback for every candidate. All communication is conducted via email, so please make sure to allow emails from @quintoandar.com.br in your inbox.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive package designed to support your health, well-being, family, and professional growth:

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, PLR (Annual Performance Bonus).

  • Health & Well-Being: Health Plan, Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Wellhub (Gympass), and QuintoCare (free psychological, legal, social, and financial support).

  • Quality of Life: Meal and Food Vouchers, Birthday Day Off, Mother's Day, and Father's Day.

  • Family & Care: Childcare Allowance, Atypical Parenting Allowance, Extended Parental Leave, and Kit Leiturinha (children's book club).

  • Education & Career: Partnerships and discounts with educational institutions.


Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

Privacy and Data Protection

Security Analyst - L2

Location: Remote (United States)
Reporting to: Cybersecurity Operations Leadership

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN is seeking a Security Analyst - L2 to support cybersecurity professional services and managed security operations across customer and internal environments. This hands-on, client-facing position assesses and improves security programs, independently investigates threats, validates technical controls, and develops practical recommendations. Unlike the dedicated Data Center SOC Analyst L2 position, this role spans broader professional-services activities including security assessments, investigations, threat hunting and operational security improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Incident Response
  • Independently triage and investigate security alerts and incidents for STN and managed-services customers; establish severity, affected assets, supporting evidence and escalation requirements.
  • Correlate endpoint, identity, firewall, network and cloud telemetry using enterprise SIEM/XDR, endpoint security and monitoring capabilities; distinguish real threats from routine operational noise.
  • Investigate suspicious authentication, privilege misuse, malware, lateral movement and potential data exfiltration; coordinate authorized containment while preserving investigation evidence and decisions.
Threat Hunting & Detection Improvement
  • Perform hypothesis-driven threat hunting, develop repeatable detection queries, tune alert logic and document visibility or coverage gaps across customer and internal environments.
  • Participate in cyber wargames, incident-readiness exercises and crisis simulations; assess response workflows, telemetry health and material monitoring blind spots.
Vulnerability Assessment & Security Control Validation
  • Assess operating system, application, identity, cloud configuration and network vulnerabilities; validate technical risk and recommend prioritized remediation.
  • Support deployment, configuration, health checks and validation of endpoint security, log collection, network segmentation, firewall policies and monitoring integrations.
  • Contribute to security control assessments, program reviews, hardening recommendations and evidence collection aligned with applicable frameworks such as NIST 800-53, HIPAA, PCI DSS and FedRAMP.
Customer Consulting & Cross-Functional Delivery
  • Partner with infrastructure, architecture, database and application teams on root-cause analysis, secure design recommendations and verification of corrective actions.
  • Prepare incident timelines, investigation reports, client-facing findings, risk assessments and executive summaries with clearly prioritized next steps.
  • Collaborate with digital forensics and incident response, engineering, automation, implementation and advisory teams to improve security posture and service quality.
Documentation & Mentorship
  • Maintain investigation playbooks, security procedures and knowledge articles; coach L1 analysts on evidence quality, investigation methods and appropriate escalation.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat detection or security professional services, including independent technical investigations.
  • Demonstrated ability to correlate SIEM/XDR, endpoint, network, identity, Windows and Linux telemetry; working knowledge of TCP/IP, authentication, endpoint behavior and common attacker techniques.
  • Experience investigating suspected compromise, collecting forensic-relevant evidence, coordinating with system owners and preparing clear case records and remediation guidance.
  • Practical experience with vulnerability assessment, secure configuration reviews and technical risk prioritization across infrastructure or applications.
  • Ability to collaborate with client stakeholders and internal security and engineering teams, including occasional after-hours response to high-priority incidents.
  • At least one current intermediate or advanced cybersecurity certification, such as CompTIA CySA+, GIAC GCIH/GCIA, or a comparable recognized blue-team credential.
Preferred
  • Experience in an MSSP, cybersecurity consultancy or other multi-customer environment, including security reviews or compliance-driven engagements.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM/XDR, EDR, network security, identity security and cloud monitoring capabilities, without requiring expertise in a particular vendor.
  • Ability to script or automate investigative tasks and use security query languages; experience improving detection engineering, threat hunting or response workflows.
Soft Skills
  • Analytical judgment: Evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence and explain the risk basis for decisions.
  • Customer communication: Translate technical findings into practical recommendations for technical and executive audiences.
  • Ownership and reliability: Independently progress investigations while documenting actions, decisions and handoffs.
  • Collaboration and mentorship: Partner effectively across teams and help improve the quality of L1 investigations.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • $70,000 - $90,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • Health Coverage - Medical, Dental & Vision
  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

About Magic

For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

Role Overview

Individual contributor, full-time, in-house at Magic. Your book of business is a set of US small-business clients, each with a Magic assistant, and your job is to keep those pairings going.

Don't mistake it for sales: there's no quota, and nobody reports to you. You read the health of each account, spot who's slipping, and move before the client raises it. Tickets come with the territory (30+ a day, answered within 2 to 4 hours).

Accounts that are looked after stay and grow, and that's what Magic's retention rests on.

Shift: Monday to Friday, 10PM to 7AM PHT (US hours), fully remote. Training runs on the same schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run your book of accounts as the main contact: onboarding sessions, 30-day check-ins, recurring follow-ups.
  • Score every account's health every 14 days, with evidence behind each note. Quiet clients don't get to stay Green.
  • Follow up with silent clients and assistants by call, email and SMS, and flag anyone who still doesn't respond.
  • Challenge a cancellation request: find the real reason, then put real retention options in front of the client before accepting it.
  • Clear 30+ tickets a day within 2 to 4 hours alongside around 20 active cases, logging every interaction in HubSpot (our CRM).
  • Advise clients and assistants on working well together, and pass recurring patterns up to leadership.

Qualifications Technical Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years in client-facing support or account management, ideally on US accounts
  • Comfortable carrying 30+ tickets a day and around 20 active cases at once
  • Accurate, up-to-date records in a CRM such as HubSpot
  • Available for US hours, 10 PM to 7 AM PHT, with at least six months of night-shift experience
  • Fluent in written and spoken English, and confident leading client calls
  • Picks up new tools and processes quickly, without hand-holding

Why You'll Be a Great Fit

You're a self-starter with clients: you call first, ask why before offering a discount or a replacement, and make a judgment call when there's no playbook. You lead clients as the expert on working with their assistant, stay organized and empathetic without being a pushover, and own a problem until it's closed.

Probably not for you if you prefer fixed procedures, wait for clients to reach out, have less than a year of client-facing experience, or would struggle with 30+ tickets a day on top of a full portfolio. Training is four intense weeks: product and skills, then live-client immersion. Zero absences (documented medical emergencies only) and at least 80% on graded assessments and mock calls are needed to continue.

  1. Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions
  2. Short written assessment (10 min)

  6. Mock feedback call (30 min)
  7. Final interview with the Head of Sales (30 min)
  8. Job offer
  9. 4-week paid training

Compensation Benefits

  • Gross package ₱36,000–₱41,000/month, total potential ₱40,000–₱45,000/month
  • Night shift (10 PM–7 AM PHT)
  • Full training program included
  • Government-mandated benefits
  • HMO
  • Paid Time Off

Why Magic?

We're ambitious, driven, and unapologetically the type to plow through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.

Graylog builds the AI-powered SIEM and log management platform that security and IT teams rely on to quickly catch threats, investigate with clarity, and control data costs — all without trade-offs. Our platform brings together scalable log management, real-time visibility, and explainable AI that supports analysts with clear insights instead of black-box guesses. It helps teams zero in on real threats, act faster, and make decisions with confidence.

More than 60,000 organizations across 180 countries use Graylog products — from Security and Enterprise to our long-standing Open edition — to gain clarity, context, and control across their environments. Rooted in open source and headquartered in Houston, we continue to grow a global community and customer base that values speed, transparency, and practical innovation.

We’re a people-first company. Remote-friendly by design, we offer the flexibility to work where you’re most effective — whether that’s one of our hubs in Hamburg, London, or Houston, or from a home office anywhere in the world. Prefer the office? Go for it. Want to hot-desk now and then? No problem. Fully remote? That works too.

And yes, it’s working. In addition to industry recognition, Graylog was named to BuiltIn’s Best Places to Work list — a reflection of how we operate and the impact our teams make every day.

If you’re looking to join a team that values curiosity, craftsmanship, and impact — and you want to build tools that make real work easier — we think you’ll feel right at home.

Role summary

Graylog is hiring a Senior Detection Engineer to build and own the detection content that small, resource-constrained security teams rely on out of the box: use cases, detection rules, dashboards, reports, and the remediation guidance that ships with them. You will be the first dedicated detection engineer on the Security Content team, and you will set the standard for how detections are defined, built, tested, documented, and shipped.

Key Responsibilities

Define and manage use cases

  • Own the detection use case lifecycle: document the business need, the threat, and the implementation for every use case, kept as versioned artifacts.
  • Turn customer threat profiles, MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, actively exploited vulnerabilities, and field feedback into a scored, visible detection backlog, working with product management.

Author detection content

  • Write detections against a normalized data model: vendor agnostic detections, single-event detections, multi-stage correlation chains, anomaly detection, writing detections based on novelty detection or baselining use cases. .
  • Focused on continuous delivery of quality detection content and documentation.
  • Work with product engineering to define the alerting capabilities detections need, such as novelty, outlier, and multi-stage query detection, so content drives the roadmap.
  • Partner with developers to support the development of additional capability to support detections.

Build detection-as-code

  • Stand up and run the separate detections repository: an open rule format, automated tests, peer review, and CI/CD.
  • Put a quality gate in front of imported third-party and community Sigma rules, so nothing ships unreviewed.
  • Review field, partner, and community contributions to the repository.

Validate, document, and tune

  • Define "done": positive and negative test data, ATT&CK mapping, a detection strategy, tuning guidance, and response guidance.
  • Be able to build guidance and procedure steps for content to provide insight to the customer on how to handle the specific threat identified. Conduct QA on detection content using tools like Atomic Red Team and Caldera for testing. Keep shipped content healthy by tuning false positives and reacting to schema drift.

Build dashboards and reports

  • Deliver the dashboards, reports, and saved searches that make each detection usable by an analyst on day one.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Write the content standard and contributing guide, and mentor newer engineers and field contributors.
  • Give the schema and parser teams structured feedback on field coverage and event categorization.
  • Capture research in a shared knowledge base so it is retained, and feed customer feedback back into the backlog.

Required qualifications

The best fit is a SOC analyst or engineer who moved into content, or a detection engineer from another SIEM vendor. This is a hands-on SIEM role rather than a pure threat-research or threat-hunting role.

  • 3 to 5+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or SIEM content development, with a track record of detections that ran in production.
  • Hands-on SIEM experience: building correlation rules, alerts, and dashboards in Graylog, Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel, QRadar, Chronicle, or similar.
  • Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, attacker TTPs, and how they appear in endpoint, identity, network, and cloud logs.
  • Experience writing Lucene Queries and Sigma rules or an equivalent open detection format, and reasoning from normalized fields (ECS,GIM, or similar) to threats rather than from vendor log strings.
  • Familiarity with code: Python or similar for tooling, tests, and automation, plus Git and pull-request workflows.
  • Experience testing detections: false-positive analysis, tuning, and positive and negative test cases.
  • Clear writing. You will produce use case definitions, tuning guidance, and response guidance that analysts rely on.
  • Ability to work independently on a small team with no existing playbook, and to set standards others follow.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with detection-as-code: rule repositories, CI pipelines, automated rule testing, and linting.
  • Familiarity with adversary emulation tools such as Atomic Red Team, Caldera, or breach-and-attack simulation platforms.
  • Experience with Graylog pipelines, event definitions, or OpenSearch queries.
  • Exposure to anomaly or statistical detection (baselining, outlier and rare-event logic), or a willingness to learn it.
  • Background in compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, PCI DSS), enough to map detections to controls.
  • Experience with cloud, container, or emerging attack surfaces such as GenAI and AI agents.
  • Prior contribution to open-source detection projects (Sigma, SigmaHQ, or similar), or published detection research.

Role Description

As a Senior Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will independently define and lead complex investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, prioritize work based on risk, develop new attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will combine practical AI security expertise with broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering teams, you will translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership through verified outcomes are essential to the role. You will help shape the Red Team’s technical direction while strengthening its tools, research methods, and testing practices. Alongside experienced researchers, you will bring your own areas of expertise, investigate emerging technologies, and advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, publish research, and see your work directly influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.
  • Share research, mentor colleagues and improve the team’s methods through lessons from completed work.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 9+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Scientific ML Engineer to build neural-operator surrogates and physics-informed models with calibrated uncertainty for our agentic engineering platform. Working with the differentiable multiphysics lead and the accelerated simulation engineer, you will stand up a parametric data factory for Hall thrusters, train surrogate physics foundation models across geometry families, build physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and other physics-informed ML models where data is scarce or solvers are expensive, and quantify uncertainty of the results.

You will be joining a new, early-stage team within Voyager's Advanced Technology Group building an AI-native engineering platform. We hire curious, highly motivated domain experts who already build with AI and have the taste to know what good looks like.

Responsibilities:

  • Stand up parametric data-generation pipelines.
  • Train neural-operator surrogates (FNO, DeepONet, mesh GNNs) across geometry families.
  • Develop physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and physics-informed ML models, including physics-informed neural operators, that embed governing equations, conservation laws, and boundary conditions through PDE-residual losses or hard constraints.
  • Combine sparse data with physics priors for data-scarce regimes, and apply physics-informed methods to inverse problems such as parameter identification and field reconstruction from test data.
  • Deliver calibrated uncertainty with coverage guarantees (conformal prediction, deep ensembles, GPs) for both data-driven and physics-informed models.
  • Use active learning so the solver runs only where the uncertainty warrants it.
  • Integrate surrogates and physics-informed models into our platform as agent-callable tools with validity envelopes.
  • Capture data and close the modeling loop with test data from live physical systems.

Required Qualifications:

  • PhD, or Master's with 5–8 years of experience, in scientific ML or a related field.
  • Neural operators or mesh-based GNNs trained on physics data.
  • Physics-informed ML (PINNs, physics-informed neural operators, or equivalent) trained against PDE residuals, with a working knowledge of known failure modes (loss balancing, stiff or multiscale problems, spectral bias) and how to mitigate them.
  • Uncertainty quantification with coverage guarantees, not just error bars.
  • Has built a parametric data-generation pipeline.
  • PyTorch or JAX, distributed GPU training, and experiment tracking.
  • Demonstrated AI-first workflow: has used agents to orchestrate solver sweeps or data pipelines.
  • S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance. TS preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Plasma or CFD domain background.
  • Geometry-aware operators.
  • Hybrid physics-informed and data-driven modeling, e.g., Bayesian PINNs, PINN-based inverse problems, or coupling PINNs with conventional solvers.
  • Active learning or Bayesian optimization.
  • Open-source contributions to SciML tooling (e.g., PhysicsNeMo, DeepXDE).

Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to Voyager locations (Los Angeles, CA; Washington, D.C.; Seattle, WA) for lab work, hardware test events, and technical reviews.

This offer is contingent upon your being a U.S. citizen and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Clearance Level U.S. Government security clearance, access eligibility, and need-to-know required for the position and applicable government contract. Clearance eligibility is determined by our U.S. Government customer.

The good faith base salary range for this role is $170,000-$225,000at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
  • Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
  • Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
  • Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
  • The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. 

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730–774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce.

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Armenia, Belarus, Georgia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://epam.com">http://epam.com</a>
</p>

<div><p>We are looking for an experienced <strong>Senior Web Application Security Engineer</strong> to join and support the client's security team. The specialist will work closely with the broader security team, covering key areas of web application protection and security operations.</p><h3>Responsibilities</h3><ul><li>Configure, tune and maintain Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules and policies using Akamai</li><li>Participate in security incident handling, investigation and resolution related to web application threats</li><li>Conduct reviews of WAF configurations, security policies and web application security posture</li><li>Identify and analyze attack patterns, anomalies and vulnerabilities targeting web applications</li><li>Provide day-to-day support to the security team, sharing expertise and best practices in web app security</li><li>Support integration of security processes across the broader team environment</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years of hands-on experience with Akamai (WAF, Kona Site Defender or similar Akamai security products)</li><li>Knowledge of web application security concepts such as OWASP Top 10, DDoS mitigation and bot management</li><li>Experience with WAF rule tuning, false positive management and security incident response</li><li>Capability to work independently and integrate quickly into an existing team</li><li>Proficiency in English communication skills</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Experience with other WAF/CDN platforms such as Cloudflare, F5 and Imperva</li><li>Familiarity with API security</li><li>Security certifications (CISSP, CEH, GWAPT etc.)</li></ul></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-web-application-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-web-application-security-engineer</a></p>

      <title>Vertican: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6696/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New Jersey, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://vertican.com">https://vertican.com</a>
</p>

<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.</p>
<p>We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.</p>
<p>We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.</p>
<p>You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.</p>
<p>This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.</p>
<h2>What you will do</h2>
<p><strong>Design the pipelines.</strong> Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.</p>
<p>We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.</p>
<p><strong>Evaluate new systems before we adopt them.</strong> Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.</p>
<p><strong>Build the evaluation process.</strong> You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Ship and operate.</strong> Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.</p>
<p><strong>Set direction.</strong> Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.</p>
<h2>What we are looking for</h2>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.</li>
<li>Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.</li>
<li>Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.</li>
<li>Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.</li>
<li>You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.</li>
<li>Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.</li>
<li>Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.</li>
<li>Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.</li>
<li>Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.</li>
<li>Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.</li>
<li>Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.</li>
<li>Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How we work and what we offer</h2>
<p>Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software</li>
<li>Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.</li>
<li>Monthly payments in USD</li>
</ul>
<p>Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vertican-senior-applied-ai-engineer-document-intelligence">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vertican-senior-applied-ai-engineer-document-intelligence</a></p>
</description>

      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
</p>

<p>Overview</p><p>A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. We are hiring cryptography experts to turn real, paid tasks from their own work into end-to-end challenges for AI agents, each with a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.</p><p>***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***</p><p>Responsibilities</p><p>• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench cryptography tasks by turning real, paid work from your own experience into challenges that an AI agent must solve end to end.</p><p>• Define the task environment, including files, systems, ciphertexts and data, so the challenge is realistic, self-contained and reproducible in a Linux command-line setup.</p><p>• Write a working reference solution in Python or SageMath that proves the task is solvable, for example by recovering a key or decrypting a secret.</p><p>• Build automated checks and tests that objectively verify the final result is correct, and explain how a mistake or a partial answer would be detected.</p><p>• Calibrate task difficulty so a typical expert needs about 60-75 minutes to solve it, keeping it hard for AI agents while still fair and unambiguous.</p><p>• Package each task with Docker and Git where applicable, document instructions clearly, and revise based on reviewer feedback until it meets the required quality bar.</p><p>Skills/Experience</p><p>• 3+ years of hands-on cryptanalysis or applied cryptography; GRC, audit-only, policy, sales or management roles do not count, nor does coursework only</p><p>• Did the work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used</p><p>• Uses the low-level tools of the subfield, such as SageMath and Python, and works comfortably on the Linux command line</p><p>• Can show how a finding is proven, such as a decrypted secret or a recovered key, and explain how a mistake would be caught</p><p>• Technical fluency with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases</p><p>• Available to start around November 2026</p><p>Nice-to-have</p><p>• Published write-ups or research on cryptanalysis</p><p>• Strong CTF results, especially in crypto categories</p><p>• CVEs discovered in cryptographic implementations</p><p>• Experience with Docker, Git and writing automated tests</p><p>• Proficiency in C for low-level cryptographic work</p><p>Process</p><p>• Task vetting: complete a vetting task instead of a live interview</p><p>• Work is paid per task, with each task taking roughly 60-75 minutes</p><p>• Expected start around early November 2026</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cryptography-specialist-for-ai-lab">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cryptography-specialist-for-ai-lab</a></p>

</p>

<p><strong><span>Senior Software Engineer, eRx Enterprise and Gadget</span></strong></p><h1>About DrFirst</h1><p>For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you’ll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!</p><h1>Position Overview</h1><p>DrFirst is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the eRx Enterprise and Gadget team. Your first focus is Gadget, our pharmacy agent. Over time you will extend your work into Rcopia, our ePrescribing platform, on Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) and Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) workflows.</p><p>You will build cloud native, high performance services for an ePrescribing collaboration platform. The platform connects providers, patients, payers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical companies in real time. You will design systems built for high load, with self healing, auto scaling, and full observability.</p><p>You bring strong judgment about AI. You know when AI speeds up delivery and when AI produces weak code. You apply AI to raise code quality, performance, and design standards across the team, and you solve real problems for the pharmacies and prescribers who rely on our platform.</p><h1>What You Will Work On</h1><div><ul><li>Build and improve Gadget, the DrFirst pharmacy agent, from design through production.</li><li>Contribute to Rcopia EPCS and PDMP capabilities as the team roadmap expands.</li><li>Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable Java integration solutions.</li><li>Build cloud native microservices on AWS with auto scaling, fault tolerance, high availability, and self healing.</li><li>Develop and maintain integrations with major EHR platforms, including athenaOne, Epic, Oracle Health, Greenway, AdvancedMD, eMDs, and ModMed, using HL7, FHIR, web services, APIs, and Mirth Connect.</li><li>Build and maintain event driven architectures with Apache Kafka for reliable, efficient service communication.</li><li>Deliver high throughput and low latency across large, distributed platforms.</li><li>Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.</li><li>Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.</li><li>Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.</li><li>Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.</li><li>Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.</li><li>Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.</li><li>Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.</li></ul></div><h1>Qualifications</h1><h2>Required</h2><div><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.</li><li>5+ years of hands on Java development with deep knowledge of object oriented design and the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.</li><li>3+ years designing and building cloud native applications on AWS, including S3, Valkey, Lambda, RDS, and EKS or ECS.</li><li>3+ years with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, with a solid grasp of event streaming.</li><li>Proven record building and integrating large scale, high performance, distributed systems with fault tolerance, scalability, and low latency.</li><li>AI first mindset, with daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.</li><li>Clear judgment on when and where AI improves engineering outcomes, and a record of keeping AI generated code from lowering quality, performance, or design.</li><li>Proficiency building and consuming RESTful APIs with JSON and XML.</li><li>Strong experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.</li><li>Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.</li><li>Solid knowledge of application and data security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection.</li><li>Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.</li><li>Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.</li><li>Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution oriented approach.</li></ul></div><h2>Preferred</h2><div><ul><li>Experience building AI agents, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows in production.</li><li>Experience with large scale, mission critical systems in finance, brokerage, trading, or credit card processing, especially systems requiring low latency, high throughput, and high availability.</li><li>Experience with ePrescribing, EPCS, PDMP, NCPDP SCRIPT, or pharmacy systems.</li><li>Familiarity with front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).</li></ul></div><h1>Physical Requirements</h1><div><ul><li>Primarily desk work in a remote, U.S. based setting.</li><li>Extended periods of computer use.</li></ul></div><p><strong><span>#LI-GF1 #LI-Remote</span></strong></p><h1>Benefits</h1><div><ul><li>Competitive compensation, with a base salary of $130,000 to $150,000 (Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience)</li><li>Eligible for a Discretionary Performance-based bonus</li><li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li><li>401K eligible after 3 months of employment, with 50% company match up to first 5% of salary contributed to the plan with a 3-year vesting schedule</li><li>HSA for eligible employees enrolled in the HDHP, with a generous company contribution up to $500 for individual coverage and $1000 for family coverage per year</li><li>100% company paid short and long-term disability, AD&amp;D, and group life insurance</li><li>Accrued annual paid time off (PTO) of 18 days for year of service</li><li>Voluntary benefits including FSA, Hospital indemnity, Accident and Critical Illness insurances</li></ul></div><p><br></p><p>DrFirst is committed to being a Remote-First company, creating a dynamic and flexible workplace where everyone thrives, no matter where they log in from. Check out our approach to remote work: <a href="https://drfirst.com/company/about-us/careers/">https://drfirst.com/company/about-us/careers/</a></p><p>Our recruitment process at DrFirst is straightforward and secure. We will never ask you for payment or sensitive personal information, such as your social security number or banking details, at any stage of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not request that you purchase equipment or accept e-checks or checks for deposit. If you encounter any communications claiming to be from DrFirst that seem suspicious, please contact our recruitment team directly at recruiter@drfirst.com to verify the message’s authenticity. Your security is important to us!</p><p>Learn more about our benefits and professional development opportunities: <a href="https://drfirst.com/company/about-us/careers/the-perks/">https://drfirst.com/company/about-us/careers/the-perks/</a></p>

challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.</p><p>• Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable.</p><p>• Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort.</p><p>• Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs.</p><p>• Package tasks with Docker and Git so they are reproducible, and document the systems, tools, data and rules involved so reviewers can validate difficulty.</p><p>• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback and agent test runs, adjusting difficulty and fixing ambiguities so each task stays expert-level, fair and objectively gradable.</p><p>Skills/Experience</p><p>• 3+ years doing ML inference or serving work hands-on (not only or evaluated models at real scale (multi-GPU or production serving), not only notebooks or API calls</p><p>• Hands-on with PyTorch or JAX internals and serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM</p><p>• Can explain how ML results go wrong without errors (numerical drift, metric bugs) and how to catch them</p><p>• Technical fluency in Python and the command line, and with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases</p><p>• Availability to start by early November 2026 and complete tasks of about 60 to 75 minutes each</p><p>Nice-to-have</p><p>• AI lab or LLM infrastructure experience</p><p>• Contributions to PyTorch, vLLM or SGLang</p><p>• GPU profiling experience</p><p>• Docker and Git proficiency</p><p>• Experience writing automated tests</p><p>Process</p><p>• Task vetting instead of an interview: complete a vetting task so the client can assess your task design</p><p>• Paid per task; each task takes about 60 to 75 minutes</p><p>• Work is delivered task by task, with reviewer feedback on submissions</p><p>• Expected start in early November 2026</p>
