</p>

<p>Company Overview:</p><p>Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets.</p><p>Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance.</p><p>We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture.</p><p>Position Overview:</p><p>As a ReelShort Screenwriter, you will be responsible for reading web novels and adapting them into compelling screenplays. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in writing and a deep knowledge and interest in romance novels or TV shows. You will need to bring order to chaos, find the right connections, and solve problems creatively. Additionally, you will provide feedback to peers and participate in script workshops.</p><p>Anyone seeking a mid-level position with at least 5 years of writing background and a strong interest in story writing (preferably in romance/drama) would be ideal for this role. If you are passionate about storytelling and have a knack for adapting written content into engaging screenplays, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity with CMS. Join us in shaping the future of interactive storytelling and HD streaming content!</p><p></p><p>Responsibilities:</p><ul><li>Read web novels to understand their themes and plots, and use them as references for writing original screenplays.</li><li>Analyze content and data to identify issues and lay out plans for optimization.</li><li>Write original content and occasionally collaborate on published content.</li><li>Utilize data to enhance in-app retention, book retention optimization, chapter conversion, new user tutorials, and marketing promotions.</li><li>Provide constructive feedback and foster team collaboration.</li></ul>
<ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of screenwriting experience.</li> <li>Strong creative screenwriting skills, particularly in romance and drama.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in History, English, Fine Arts, Screenwriting, or a related field.</li> <li>Comfortable writing young adult romance/drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills.</li> <li>Strong interest in reading novels.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of the online reading or publishing industry, both historical and current.</li> <li>Passion for content creation and prior experience in the field is a plus.</li> <li>Ability to work well under pressure and possess strong interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Flexibility to work across different time zones.</li> <li>Eagerness to learn and gain experience in the gaming and content industry.</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.</li> </ul>
<p>Crazy Maple Studio, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.</p><p></p><p>Given the high volume of applications, and to ensure a fair and efficient process for all candidates, our interview process typically includes the following steps: writing assessment → screening call → hiring manager interview.</p><p></p><p>Thank you for your interest and understanding. Let’s create great stories together!</p>

      <title>Custom Mechanical Solutions: Quality and Reliability Engineer</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://cmswa.com">http://cmswa.com</a>
</p>

<div><p>Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress.</p>
<p>If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. &nbsp;We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.</p></div><h2>About Custom Mechanical Solutions</h2>
<p>Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support.</p>
<p>As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization.</p>
<p><strong>Title:</strong> Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer<br><strong>Department:</strong> CMS National Accounts<br><strong>Location:</strong> Fully remote within the United States<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel</p>
<p><strong>Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes.</strong></p>
<p>Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales.</p>
<h1>The opportunity</h1>
<p>CMS is looking for a Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects.</p>
<p>Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions.</p>
<h1>What you will own</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead field-to-factory investigations. </strong>Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure.</li>
<li><strong>Turn field intelligence into action. </strong>Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation.</li>
<li><strong>Create field-ready solutions. </strong>Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence.</li>
<li><strong>Drive clarity and accountability. </strong>Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed.</li>
<li><strong>Use data to improve the program. </strong>Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners.</li>
<li><strong>Go where the evidence is. </strong>Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness.</li>
</ul>
<h1>You will probably love this role if...</h1>
<ul>
<li>When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer.</li>
<li>You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly.</li>
<li>You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed.</li>
<li>You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved.</li>
<li>You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Required qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience.</li>
<li>At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support.</li>
<li>Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure.</li>
<li>Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.</li>
<li>Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico.</li>
<li>A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Preferred qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience.</li>
<li>Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes.</li>
<li>Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations.</li>
<li>Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards.</li>
<li>Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience.</li>
<li>This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus.</li>
<li>Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Why CMS National Accounts</h1>
<p>You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio.</p>
<p><strong>If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p><div><p></p>
<p><span>Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. &nbsp;Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship.</span></p>
<p><span>Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location.</span></p></div>

</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of<em> Inc.’s Best Workplaces</em> six times in the past seven years.</p>
<p>We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.&nbsp; The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit <a href="http://knock.com/">Knock.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Lending Manager (Front End)</strong></p>
<p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p><strong>Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. This is a 100% remote role, and you’ll lead a team distributed across the country. You enjoy building teams, finding efficiencies, and using technology to improve how work gets done. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.</strong></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Lead and develop the team</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Manage, lead, and scale the remote Loan Assistant team. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Share weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual team and company goals, and make sure the team meets and exceeds expectations.Hold team members accountable for their performance.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Build camaraderie and teamwork in a virtual environment through team meetings and regular 1:1 check-ins.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Run virtual training for new Loan Assistants and serve as the team’s go-to for escalations, questions, and exceptions.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Own the pipeline</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Manage the bridge loan pipeline from setup through initial disclosure and submission, and through post-closing. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Coach the team and give feedback along the way.Balance workloads across the team to meet company SLAs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Support post-closing review. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Work loans that have findings with the team member responsible and get them resolved.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Work closely with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing to give everyone timely, accurate service.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Compile team scorecard data each quarter to track KPIs and quality.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Improve how we work</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Help the Director of Lending Operations find gaps in process and policy across the Loan Assistant and post-closing functions. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Write or update procedures for review, training, and rollout, then follow up to make sure the changes stick.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Set best practices and change the workflow when needed so the team runs efficiently and meets company KPIs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Take on ad hoc projects and step in wherever your team needs support.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>At least 10 years of relevant mortgage experience, including 5 or more years directly managing a fully remote team</strong></li>
<li><strong>Experience managing mortgage loan processing and/or post-closing teams</strong></li>
<li><strong>A track record of coaching teams and helping them succeed</strong></li>
<li><strong>Working knowledge of federal, state, and local mortgage regulatory compliance</strong></li>
<li><strong>Strong written and virtual communication skills</strong></li>
<li><strong>You keep a distributed team aligned, engaged, and accountable using tools like Slack and video meetings</strong></li>
<li><strong>A strong focus on customer service. You go above and beyond to “wow” the people you serve.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Close attention to detail. You check your work carefully and catch the small things, so your work is consistently accurate.</strong></li>
<li><strong>A commitment to diverse, equitable, and inclusive practices that support Knock’s values of making an impact, learning, putting people first, being open, and being courageous</strong></li>
<li><strong>High school diploma or equivalent experience</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Physical Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Set up and constantly operate a computer</strong></li>
<li><strong>Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated.&nbsp; Please note that the salary range information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act for Colorado applicants. </strong></p>
<p><strong>The salary range estimate for this position is: $90,000 - $100,000 + company incentive plan (bonus) USD. </strong></p>
<p><strong>This job opening expires December 31, 2026.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="section page-centered">
<div class="content-wrapper posting-page">
<div class="content">
<div class="section-wrapper page-full-width">
<div class="section page-centered">

<p>The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package &amp; benefits, will be at the company’s sole discretion, and determined by factors including but not limited to years of experience, job level, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. The company also reserves the right to amend or modify this job description, employee perks, and benefits at any time. Employees eligible for bonus and/or commission will be provided details in the offer letter.</p>
<p><strong></strong><strong>Why Knock</strong></p>
<p> Purpose-Driven Work: Your contributions will improve the homeownership journey for thousands of individuals and families.<br> Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a flexible, people-first approach.<br> Innovative Culture: Collaborate with curious, talented colleagues in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. To learn more about the culture at Knock, view our <a href="https://a-us.storyblok.com/f/1005183/x/a6121f1519/knock_culture_popsicle.pdf">POPSICLE values</a>.<br> Commitment to Inclusion: We are dedicated to creating diverse teams and an inclusive, respectful culture where everyone belongs.</p>
<p><strong> Enjoying Life &amp; Making an Impact</strong></p>
<p> Since our founding in 2015, Knock has and continues to offer a <strong>100% remote work culture<br></strong> Top tier medical, dental, &amp; vision benefits for full time employees starting on the first day of employment<br> Flexible Paid Time Off for full time employees<br> Paid parental leave for all full time employees:<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; - 12 weeks paid parental leave for the birthing parent<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; - 6 weeks paid parental leave for the non-birthing parent<br> One thousand annually for professional development<br>️ Life, AD&amp;D and Disability insurance for full time employees<br> 401K (noncontributory by Knock) for all employees<br> $75 monthly allowance for health &amp; wellness<br> Up to $400 monthly for a co-working space for eligible employees<br> $100 monthly allowance for home internet, mobile phone or other communication devices<br> $2,500 referral bonus for eligible employees</p>
<p><strong>️ Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p>
<p>Knock provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable US federal, state, or local laws.</p>
<p><strong> Internal Applicants</strong></p>
<p>If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.</p>
<p><strong> Remote Culture &amp; Company Mission</strong></p>
<p>We are proud to be a remote, distributed company with employees across 17 states and counting. This is an amazing opportunity to be an integral part of building a multi-billion dollar consumer brand in an industry that is long overdue for a new way of doing things. You will be working with a passionate team that is disrupting the status quo.</p>
<p>Knock, and its subsidiaries, are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable US federal, state, or local laws.</p>

      <title>ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Product Management, Growth</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.</p></div><h1>Principal Product Manager, Growth</h1>
<h2>About ZoomInfo</h2>
<p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute — you'll make things happen, fast.</p>
<h2>The Opportunity</h2>
<h3>Own a Growth Portfolio and Set the Pattern the Rest of the Team Inherits</h3>
<p>ZoomInfo built the industry's most sophisticated GTM data platform. The next frontier is turning every visitor into revenue without waiting on a human handoff — a coherent self-serve journey that activates a non-customer in minutes, converts consumption into upgrade, and routes high-intent signals back to sales when a human will close more than they distract.</p>
<p>You'll define the multi-quarter thesis on which channels compound, the operating rhythm the rest of the growth PM team inherits, and the ZoomInfo POV on how buyers discover us in an AI-first world.</p>
<p>The impact is immediate and compounding. Every signup you activate, every credit you cause to be consumed, every transaction, every PQL you route, every "buy more" event you trigger is revenue — and every operating pattern you set multiplies across the growth PM group. We've adopted a consumption-first monetization model and a unified entry-point thesis across the company, and we run weekly: if your hypothesis can't be falsified inside a sprint, it isn't a hypothesis. This is a rare opportunity to own a P&amp;L-shaped surface with full air cover to ship fast, learn in public, re-pivot when the data turns — and to define the growth PM craft as ZoomInfo scales it.</p>
<h2>What You'll Do</h2>
<h3>Own the Portfolio End-to-End</h3>
<p>Take a portfolio-scope growth surface — and own it from first impression to revenue. Define the entry points, the activation milestones, the monetization moments, and the sales-assist signals across the channels that make up the portfolio. Drive the user experience across surfaces: landing, signup, in-product onboarding, empty states, upgrade modals, paywalls, lifecycle communication, and the agent-readable / LLM-discovery surfaces that are becoming primary. You own the funnel chart; you own the why behind every drop.</p>
<h3>Set the Multi-Quarter Growth Thesis</h3>
<p>Beyond weekly experiments, own 4-8 quarter bets on which channels compound and which retire. Publish a written POV on where PLG distribution is heading (LLM-first discovery, MCP-as-channel, agent-readable onboarding, partner-driven trials) and defend the sequencing to the exec team. Rebalance investment across the portfolio quarterly based on unit economics, not the loudest channel.</p>
<h3>Run Experimentation as the Operating Rhythm — and Set the Rhythm for the Team</h3>
<p>Ship 8-10 experiments per sprint. Pre-register the hypothesis, the metric, the success threshold, and — critically — the invalidation signal. Read results weekly, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does, and keep a written record so the team compounds learning instead of repeating it. Your rubric, your retro format, and your invalidation-signal standard become the template the rest of the Growth PM group inherits. Translate results into concrete changes: copy rewrites, schema tweaks, pricing changes, new flows, retired ones. Close the loop with engineering, design, and analytics inside the same week.</p>
<h3>Design Self-Serve as a First-Class Path</h3>
<p>Most users on your portfolio never speak to sales before they hit a "buy more" moment. Your in-product copy, paywall framing, empty states, activation paths, and upgrade triggers are the product. Apply growth-engineering rigor — credit economics, consumption pacing, signal routing, lifecycle messaging, intelligent gating — so the right offer lands in front of the right user at exactly the right moment. Hand high-intent users to sales with a clean signal; absorb low-intent users with a clean self-serve path.</p>
<h3>Diagnose the Funnel With Data, Not Vibes</h3>
<p>Data is your default tool, not a thing you ask analytics to do for you. You independently analyze the funnel, segment the cohort, find the leak, and propose the fix — then validate it with an experiment. You know when to trust a 5% lift and when to call it noise. Just as important: you know when to zoom out from a specific funnel drop to a portfolio-level rebalance, and can defend that call.</p>
<h3>Shape the Monetization Mechanic</h3>
<p>You'll design the credit economics of your portfolio: what's free, what's gated, what gets a "buy more" prompt, what triggers a PQL. You'll model the unit economics — credit cost, revenue per credit, upgrade rate, expansion rate — and you'll defend the pricing decisions in front of finance and sales leadership with the math.</p>
<h3>Orchestrate Across Sales, Marketing, and CS</h3>
<p>Self-serve doesn't mean alone. You'll route PQLs into the right hands (AE, SC, AM, or no one), partner with marketing on acquisition and lifecycle, and work with CS to understand why activated users churn before upgrade. You'll run the operating cadences that keep your portfolio aligned with the broader PLG portfolio without becoming a meeting machine.</p>
<h3>Multiply the Team</h3>
<p>Help hire and calibrate the Sr Growth PMs owning adjacent loops. Coach them into ownership. Your retro is their template; your experiment quality is their bar. Raise the craft of the whole Growth PM group as it scales.</p>
<h3>Stay Honest About What's Working</h3>
<p>Write retrospectives that name the wrong calls as cleanly as the right ones. Update your priors publicly when the data turns. Hold strong opinions weakly. The team that ships the most experiments isn't the team that's right the most — it's the team that updates the fastest.</p>
<h2>What You'll Bring</h2>
<ul>
<li>8–12 years of product management experience, with 4+ years specifically in growth, PLG, or self-serve product roles</li>
<li>Direct P&amp;L ownership at portfolio scope — a loop or portfolio you've driven from &lt;$X to &gt;$Y with your name on the number, not a feature inside someone else's loop</li>
<li>Experience presenting to CEO / CRO / CFO / board on growth mechanics — the credit-economics deck, the funnel narrative, the "kill this bet" moment</li>
<li>Track record of hiring, mentoring, or calibrating other growth PMs — comfortable being the bar</li>
<li>You're a builder. You ship landing pages, signup flows, and in-product experiments — not specs that sit in Jira. You sit with designers and engineers, write copy, and prototype with code.</li>
<li>AI-fluent with a public POV. You understand that LLMs are becoming a primary discovery surface. You have opinions — publishable ones — about agent-readable flows, MCP-as-distribution, GEO/AEO, and how an AI agent's recommendation impacts a funnel.</li>
<li>Marketing-fluent. You hold your own with SEO, paid acquisition, content, and lifecycle marketing teams as a peer, not a consumer.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of running structured experimentation (A/B tests, multivariate, holdouts, pre/post) at sprint cadence — including at cohort sizes where 50/50 doesn't have power</li>
<li>Strong analytics fluency — comfortable in Snowflake without analyst hand-holding</li>
<li>Working knowledge of consumption-based pricing, credit economics, freemium mechanics, and PQL frameworks</li>
<li>B2B SaaS background; data, GTM, or sales-tech domain experience is a plus but not required</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who You Are</h2>
<h3>Core Competencies</h3>
<p>Funnel Foundation. Expert-level understanding of full-funnel growth. You can reason about activation rates, time-to-value, retention curves, credit economics, upgrade triggers, and PQL signal quality with depth. You've owned a growth loop — or portfolio — in production. SQL and analytics fluency let you diagnose a funnel drop, prototype the fix, and validate it in the same week.</p>
<p>Portfolio Thinking. You reason about ToF (or an equivalent surface) as a portfolio of channels with different unit economics, decay curves, and compounding dynamics — not a single funnel. You rebalance investment quarterly based on where marginal dollars return the most, and you can defend the rebalance to leadership with the math.</p>
<p>Experimentation Discipline. You don't ship without a hypothesis. You pre-register the metric and the invalidation signal before the test runs. You read results honestly, kill losing variants without ego, and document learnings so the team compounds knowledge instead of relitigating settled questions. You know the difference between an experiment and a launch — and you can tell when each is the right move.</p>
<p>Category POV. You have a public, defensible point of view on where PLG distribution is heading — agent-readable surfaces, MCP-as-channel, GEO/AEO, LLM-first onboarding — grounded in benchmarks from peer companies (Clay, Linear, Vercel, Cursor, Notion), not just internal data. That POV shows up in the roadmap.</p>
<p>Distribution Mindset. Experience designing growth surfaces where sales teams, marketing teams, and self-serve users are simultaneously your customers. You measure success through revenue, consumption, and expansion velocity, not screens shipped. You understand growth economics: each additional entry point, freemium offer, or AI trial compounds in value through shared activation patterns, amortized acquisition costs, and recurring consumption network effects.</p>
<p>Operational Velocity. You read the funnel daily, not quarterly. You prototype emerging mechanics — paywalls, in-app prompts, lifecycle sequences — to understand their practical constraints before committing engineering time. You hold strong opinions weakly, updating your design assumptions as evidence accumulates, publicly, even when the prior thesis was your own.</p>
<p>Strategic Communication. You translate between funnel depth and business impact fluently. You can explain to the CEO why a credit pricing change is worth a quarter of work. You can communicate to engineers why a revenue constraint requires a "quiet release" in two weeks rather than a polished launch in three months. You influence without formal authority through forcing functions, falsifiable invalidation signals, and earned credibility.</p>
<p>Talent Leverage. You coach Sr PMs into full ownership of their loops. Your retro is their template. Your experiment quality is their bar. You help hire the next PMs on the team, and you calibrate — you know what "great" looks like at Sr level and you can articulate the gap to someone who isn't there yet.</p>
<p>Copy Instinct. Microcopy is part of your craft, not someone else's job. You can rewrite a paywall headline, an upgrade modal, an empty state, or an onboarding CTA on instinct — and defend the rewrite with PLG principles. You know when to ask content design for help and when to ship the rewrite yourself.</p>
<h2>The Environment</h2>
<h3>Reporting, Pace &amp; Impact</h3>
<p>Reporting &amp; Collaboration. Report to the VP Product, PLG. Peer to the Sr Directors of Marketing, Sales Operations, and Customer Success on the growth contracts (PQL routing, demand-gen alignment, credit economics). Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the engineering and design leaders building the underlying surfaces, the GTM leaders routing PQLs into sales, and a peer PM group covering monetization, lifecycle, viral, onboarding, and analytics. Regular exposure to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and CFO — you own those conversations at your level.</p>
<p>Pace &amp; Problems. Fast-moving teams that understand the space. Weekly experimentation cadence layered under 4-quarter portfolio bets. Expect interesting problems: How do we win activation in a user's first 60 seconds? When should two trial flows become one? How do we expose enough value to convert without giving away the platform? How do we price a credit so that customers consume more, not less? When should a self-serve user be routed to sales — and when does that routing actually destroy revenue? How do buyers discover ZoomInfo when discovery goes through Claude and ChatGPT? Your decisions become operating patterns across the PLG organization.</p>
<p>Impact. Own a portfolio-scope growth surface at a company that is already AI-first in product thinking and consumption-first in monetization. Your decisions compound. Every improvement to the funnel, the offer, or the activation experience multiplies across multiple products, every partner-driven self-serve channel ZoomInfo ships into, and every AI distribution surface we haven't yet imagined — and every operating pattern you set makes the next PM on the team better.</p>
<p>What changed at a glance:</p>
<ul>
<li>Title + opening reframed from loop-scope → portfolio-scope, ToF-leaning but flexible</li>
<li>Three new sections in What You'll Do: Set the Multi-Quarter Thesis, Represent PLG to Leadership, Multiply the Team</li>
<li>Seniority bar: 4-7 yrs → 8-12 yrs; adds direct P&amp;L ownership, exec/board presenting, hiring/mentoring</li>
<li>Two new competencies: Portfolio Thinking, Category POV, Talent Leverage</li>
<li>Reporting line: Sr Director → VP Product, PLG; peer to CRO/CMO/CFO direct reports</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position. Additional compensation such as Bonus, Commission, Equity and other benefits may also apply.</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$151,900</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$238,700 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.</p>

      <title>Oportun: Senior ML Engineer (R14284)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span><span>A Quick Note on the Role's Focus</span></span></h2>
<p>While the title is <strong>Senior ML Engineer</strong>, this opportunity is specifically focused on <strong>ML Platform Engineering </strong>rather than<strong> </strong>ML model development or data science.</p>
<p>We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. The emphasis is on <strong>ML infrastructure, MLOps, model serving, platform reliability, and production engineering</strong>, rather than primarily developing, training, or fine-tuning ML models.</p>
<h2><span><span><br>Location Note</span></span></h2>
<p><span>We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, <strong>the role must be performed from within India.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span><br>The Opportunity</span></h2>
<p><span>The <strong>Machine Learning Platform</strong> team builds the software foundations that enable data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and operate models safely and efficiently in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform.</span></p>
<h2><span>At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business.<br><br></span></h2>
<h2><span>What You'll Do</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll lead the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of complex platform capabilities that support the machine-learning lifecycle.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll design scalable systems for model deployment and serving, feature computation, data validation, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production support.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build reusable platform components, standards, and automation while improving reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness across ML systems.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll own significant technical initiatives end to end and lead complex production investigations—clarifying requirements, leading design, delivering safely, measuring results, and implementing durable fixes.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll raise engineering quality through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentor engineers through pairing and technical guidance, and contribute to platform technical strategy.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Who You Are</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>The right fit looks like this</strong></span></p>
<p><span>You do not need detailed implementation direction to be effective. Given an ambiguous problem and sufficient context, you can define the technical approach, explain trade-offs, align stakeholders, lead delivery, and own the outcome after launch.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>You’re comfortable navigating complexity and don’t wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, mentor others, and connect engineering work to member, business, and operational outcomes.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span>What You Bring</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ve demonstrated experience designing and operating reliable, scalable cloud-native services or data-intensive systems, with experience in ML platforms, model serving, feature engineering, data platforms, MLOps, or related systems.</span></li>
<li><span>You bring practical experience with SQL, databases, caching, and tracing data or requests across multiple systems, plus familiarity with the ML lifecycle from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance.</span></li>
<li><span>You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and production observability, and you can evaluate technical alternatives and clearly communicate recommendations, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ve demonstrated the ability to mentor engineers, improve engineering practices, lead through technical influence, and connect engineering work to member, business, product, and operational outcomes.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience with AWS, Databricks, MLflow, SageMaker, Spark/PySpark, Kafka, or streaming systems.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building feature platforms, model-serving systems, workflow-orchestration platforms, or internal developer platforms.</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with monitoring model quality, data quality, feature coverage, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency, and experience working with sensitive data in a regulated or financial-services environment.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with Java or another backend language in addition to Python, and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve personal productivity.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<p><span><strong><span>We b</span>uild with AI. We lead with judgment.</strong></span></p>
<p><span>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together</strong>.</span></span></p>
<h2><span>Why Oportun</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>What's in it for you</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.</span></p>
<p><span>Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:</span></p>
<p><span><strong>India Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision Insurance</span></p>
<p><span>Provident Fund</span></p>
<p><span>Life &amp; Accident Insurance</span></p>
<p><span>Internet, Fuel, Meal &amp; Telephone Allowances</span></p>
<p><span>Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit <span><strong>oportun.com/careers&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp; <span>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1</span></span></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.</span></em></p>

<p><em><span>California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:&nbsp; <a href="https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/">https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/</a>.</span></em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em><span>We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).</span></em></p></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Mexico
</p>

<h2><span class=" author-d-iz88z86z86za0dz67zz78zz78zz74zz68zjz80zz71z9iz90z8h00wiph6z86zz86z7z89z3z66zz68z0z82zxz68zz67z1z74z8z79z7z70zz67zcyz80z"><strong>Role Description</strong></span></h2>
<p><span class=" author-d-1gg9uz65z1iz85zgdz68zmqkz84zo2qoxwoz79zz81zdz83zj3z80ziz65zz90zgz82zz67zz84zifm1w1z73zz89z3z73zz86zz90zz68zn5">As a Product Engineer at Dropbox, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of collaboration and file sharing. Your responsibilities will revolve around developing and enhancing our suite of Dropbox Products to deliver exceptional user experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, turning innovative ideas into robust, scalable, and user-friendly features.</span></p>

      <title>GitLab: Backend Engineer, Knowledge Graph</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Canada; Remote, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p>
<p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p>
<p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li>
<li>Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li>
<li>Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li>
<li>Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.</li>
<li>Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.</li>
<li>Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.</li>
<li>Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li>
<li>Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.</li>
<li>Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li>
<li>Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li>
<li>Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li>
<li>A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li>
<li>Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li>
<li>Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p>
<p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.</p>
<p>We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. A key challenge for us right now is scaling sustainably as usage grows and team members take time off. That includes hardening multi-tenant behavior. At the same time, we're bringing Knowledge Graph to</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$115,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$162,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>

<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.       <title>Jumio: Principal Enterprise Architect</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India (remote)
</p>

<h1><strong>Enterprise Architect - Cloud &amp; AI</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2>
<p>Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary <strong>AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect</strong>, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a <strong>Developer Advocate</strong> and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.</p>
<p>This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.</p>
<p>As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>End-to-End System Architecture &amp; Optimization</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.</li>
<li>Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.</li>
<li>Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.</li>
<li>Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).</li>
<li>Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Data &amp; AI Infrastructure</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.</li>
<li>Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.</li>
<li>Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.</li>
<li>Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Hands-on Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.</li>
<li>Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.</li>
<li>Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>GenAI Acceleration &amp; Architectural Advocacy</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.</li>
<li>You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.</li>
<li>Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Architectural Governance &amp; ARC Leadership</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.</li>
<li>Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.</li>
<li>Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.</li>
<li>Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.</li>
<li>Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.</li>
<li>Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.</li>
<li>System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.</li>
<li>Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.</li>
<li>Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.</li>
<li>Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.</li>
<li>Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Must-Have Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.</li>
<li>Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.</li>
<li>Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.</li>
<li>Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.</li>
<li>Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.</li>
<li>Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.</li>
<li>Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).</li>
<li>Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python,&nbsp; Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript &amp; Kotlin).</li>
<li>Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.</li>
<li>Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.</li>
<li>Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.</li>
<li>Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Impact at scale</strong>—we process <strong>millions of transactions</strong> and solve <strong>real-world security and identity challenges</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Modern technical foundation with room to innovate</strong>—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on architecture leadership</strong>—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.</li>
<li><strong>Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts</strong>, pushing the limits of what’s possible.</li>
<li><strong>Competitive compensation and high ownership</strong>—your work will define how Jumio scales.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>
<p><strong>Applicant Data Privacy </strong></p>
<p>We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s <a href="https://www.jumio.com/legal-information/privacy-notices/candidate-notice/">Applicant Privacy Notice.</a> If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to <a href="mailto:privacy@jumio.com">privacy@jumio.com</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect</a></p>

      <title>Salesloft: HR Enablement Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>HR Enablement Lead</strong></p>
<p><strong>Job Location: United States, Remote&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><em>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</em></p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, as&nbsp;our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.</p>
<p>You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&amp;D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own program lifecycles. </strong>Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.</li>
<li><strong>Create and lead workshops. </strong>Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Partner with People Business Partners. </strong>Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.</li>
<li><strong>Ramp front-line managers. </strong>Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.</li>
<li><strong>Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. </strong>Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.</li>
<li><strong>Enable the People team. </strong>Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.</li>
<li><strong>Shape the learning architecture. </strong>Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with AI. </strong>Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.</li>
<li><strong>Drive business execution. </strong>Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.</li>
<li><strong>Run the learning platform. </strong>Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&amp;D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.</li>
<li><strong>Analyze and interpret. </strong>Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>5+ years of combined experience </strong>in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.</li>
<li><strong>Workshop facilitation: </strong>Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).</li>
<li><strong>Manager and onboarding programs: </strong>Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional innovation: </strong>Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic partnership: </strong>Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li><strong>AI and technical aptitude: </strong>Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.</li>
<li><strong>Systems thinking: </strong>Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.</li>
<li><strong>Program ownership: </strong>Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on execution: </strong>A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Communication and influence: </strong>Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional design: </strong>Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.</li>
<li><strong>Measurement: </strong>Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.</li>
</ul>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official&nbsp;<a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>#LI-REMOTE</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$85,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$110,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead</a></p>
</description>
